note: The recorded differences concern orthography and punctuation. The witnesses agree on the substantive text they cover.

adjudicated.ruling: The j-form against this edition's i-form, by the house rule in ORTHOGRAPHY.md. This edition prints i because the books it edits do: the approved 1962 Benziger printing sets Iesu, Ioánnem, iube and maiestátis throughout, and so does the Mszał Rzymski of the Tyniec Benedictines (Pallottinum, Poznań 1963), which is the book a Polish reader is most likely to hold. The mid-century hand missals print j; neither spelling is a different word, and the apparatus records theirs.

Colon, with the approved Benziger printing, which sets fidem Ecclésiæ tuæ: eámque (p. 314), and with handmissal-eo. Witness do and the separately set Vatican printing of the 1962 Missal set a semicolon here. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.
